name: Oroz-Betelu / Orotz-Betelu (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the arms of Oroz-Betelu (a laurel wreath on red).
history: Municipal flag of Oroz-Betelu/Orotz-Betelu; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Oroz-Betelu arms — laurel wreath on red
